# move a pointer receiver method to a function
mv T.Method Func
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func (t *T) Method() int {
	return t.X
}

func F(t *T) int {
	return t.Method()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,10 +2,10 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func (t *T) Method() int {
+func Func(t *T) int {
 	return t.X
 }

 func F(t *T) int {
-	return t.Method()
+	return Func(t)
 }
